mission: Design falsification journeys for 10/20/50-worker races, sequential chains, stale recovery, page-level integration and parent disappearance.

omitted_but_available: historical source families not required to test the current worker transport/lifecycle contract
surface-specific content bodies except their queue/claim/return state
contradictions_surfaced: published gh-pages runtime may lag or lead the immediately observed main head during a hot worker wave; tests must record both instead of treating either projection alone as atomic global truth

runtime_observations_from_this_run.observation: Create-if-absent attempts on higher-priority claim paths lost races without overwrite; existing-file semantics caused the worker to re-enter allocation.
runtime_observations_from_this_run.implication: A broad-wave PASS must count collision loss plus safe reallocation, not only distinct final claims.

runtime_observations_from_this_run.observation: After this opportunity was exclusively claimed, the first append-only STARTED run write to its own previously absent path failed with HTTP 409 because main advanced concurrently. A fresh read confirmed the run path was still absent; retry then succeeded and produced durable STARTED evidence.
runtime_observations_from_this_run.implication: Exclusive opportunity ownership does not guarantee transport-level write progress on a hot shared Git branch. Remote write retry/reload behavior must be part of the stress gate.

runtime_observations_from_this_run.observation: Existing candidates already report 11/11 lease/retry tests, 11/11 dynamic-readiness tests, 8/8 multi-stage continuation tests and 11/11 allocator tests, while their own boundaries still require broad-wave or remote integration evidence.
runtime_observations_from_this_run.implication: S4 should exercise composition and real durable transport rather than merely rerun local behavior harnesses.

route_changing_finding.statement: A 50-worker stress test that proves only unique claims can false-pass. The test must separately prove logical exclusivity, lifecycle durability under unrelated main-head churn, dependency/integration correctness, and recovery/authority safety.
route_changing_finding.reason: This run observed a real 409 on an isolated own-run append while other workers advanced main; unit-level claim exclusivity did not prevent it.

falsification_journeys.purpose: Prove create-if-absent exclusivity and loser behavior on one READY exclusive opportunity.
falsification_journeys.setup: Ten fresh identical /wc workers see the same eligible target at the same queue epoch.
must_observe: exactly one durable exclusive claim
only the winner persists STARTED for that opportunity
losers perform no substantive writes for the lost target
losers reload and select another safe lane or prove idle
falsifiers: loser stops after collision while safe work exists

falsification_journeys.purpose: Separate path-level exclusivity from Git main-head transport contention.
falsification_journeys.setup: Twenty workers claim distinct isolated opportunities/own evidence paths.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Persist claim -> STARTED -> checkpoint -> RETURN -> terminal run while main is actively advancing.
must_observe: all accepted workers eventually persist complete lifecycle lineage
409/head-change conflicts trigger refetch/retry rather than false failure
retries never transform into overwrite of foreign scope
no missing RETURN caused solely by unrelated main churn
falsifiers: distinct paths still lose lifecycle evidence permanently
worker treats generic branch-head conflict as proof another owner exists

falsification_journeys.purpose: Test useful durable output under mixed prepared work, collisions, derived readiness, critics and surplus workers.
falsification_journeys.setup: Approximately fifty identical fresh /wc workers enter one live wave with the real queue and current runtime.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Allow natural races, dependency transitions and queue pressure.
must_observe: high distinct-or-intentionally-complementary claim ratio
safe collision recovery
no unsafe duplicate exclusive execution
durable RETURN/DONE lineage survives write contention
newly unblocked work is derived from exact RETURN+DONE evidence
surplus workers discover/recover/criticize only when authorized
human routing actions remain zero after bootstrap
falsifiers: unique claims but material orphaned lifecycle evidence
occupancy rises while useful durable returns stall
manual queue status edits are required to unblock successors
human must courier results or route workers

falsification_journeys.purpose: Prove sequential chaining without converting one chat into a permanent owner.
falsification_journeys.setup: A is owned and B is dependency-blocked on A. A completion produces matching RETURN+DONE evidence.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: The A worker and a fresh allocator worker both discover B as READY_DERIVED and race its claim.
must_observe: readiness proof references exact A run+return
exactly one B claim winner
winner alone starts B
loser re-enters allocation
independent sibling successors remain parallel
falsifiers: B starts from RETURN without DONE
prior A authority leaks into B when B requires different context/authority

falsification_journeys.purpose: Falsify unsafe takeover and verify late-original reconciliation.
falsification_journeys.setup: Original run has STARTED and durable heartbeat/checkpoint lineage; no RETURN. Use controlled timestamps around 20m and 30m thresholds.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Probe at <20m, 20-29m, >=30m; then create an append-only recovery attempt only when all gates pass; finally let original return late.
must_observe: no takeover from time alone before eligibility
new heartbeat cancels stale assumption
recovery claim preserves original evidence
target refetch/CAS and overlap checks precede write
late original and recovery returns are both preserved and require reconciliation

falsification_journeys.purpose: Prove page-level integration leaves the global guide without creating four unsafe mini-guides.
falsification_journeys.setup: Each of control-plan, prometeo-mobile, facultad-digital and alumnos-teacher has all required local lens RETURNS plus the shared local-steward/page-thread prerequisites.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Derive four local integration successors READY and run their stewards concurrently.
must_observe: each steward writes only its surface candidate/integration scope
shared-owner conflicts are detected before mutation
local return contains reconciled intent/truth/UX/reuse/risk/discovery/plan evidence
next-wave opportunities are durable
no local steward self-promotes Current/Human Accepted/Served
falsifiers: one surface steward edits another surface
global guide required for routine merge

falsification_journeys.purpose: Prove durable reincarnation while active work exists.
falsification_journeys.setup: Active claims/runs plus at least one returned candidate and one dependency-blocked successor exist.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Discard the parent conversation. Open a fresh guide using only the stable reincarnation path; provide no transcript, routing table or result couriering.
must_observe: fresh parent reconstructs identity, authority, active work, returned evidence, blockers and next safe action from durable state
it does not ask the human to restate the plan
it detects any newly READY successor from durable evidence
existing workers remain valid without the old parent
falsifiers: mistakes candidate RETURN for promoted authority

falsification_journeys.purpose: Ensure hot-wave gh-pages/runtime projections cannot silently override fresher source truth.
falsification_journeys.setup: Workers observe main and compiled runtime/epoch at different instants while main advances.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Force a decision whose safety depends on current target ownership or dependency evidence.
must_observe: receipt records both source head and runtime epoch/main observation
material writes refetch exact target/current SHA
stale projection causes reload/hold, not unsafe overwrite
queue source status is not edited merely to match projection
falsifiers: compiled projection treated as atomic current truth despite fresher conflicting target evidence

falsification_journeys.purpose: Verify worker quantity cannot amplify candidate authority into product authority.
falsification_journeys.setup: Multiple workers return mutually consistent candidates recommending the same promotion.
falsification_journeys.perturbation: Attempt normal post-return continuation and integration paths.
must_observe: agreement does not auto-promote Human Accepted/Current/Served
authority-changing action remains separately authorized
returns remain immutable evidence
critic disagreement is preserved rather than averaged away
falsifiers: local steward inherits global promotion rights

falsification_journeys.purpose: Test behavior when prepared READY work drains before worker supply.
falsification_journeys.setup: All compatible prepared work is claimed/blocked and workers remain available.
must_observe: recovery candidates outrank low-value discovery when eligible
discovery/proposals are deduplicated and evidence-backed
IDLE_NO_SAFE_USEFUL_WORK requires explicit exhaustion proof
no filler tasks are invented for occupancy
falsifiers: unsafe recovery skipped for cosmetic discovery
worker invents work solely to remain busy

stress_gate_minimum_evidence.prohibited_false_pass: Do not declare broad-wave success from claim uniqueness or local unit tests alone.

recommended_next_work.action: Extend the existing S4 stress verifier acceptance contract with J20-DISJOINT-LIFECYCLE-TRANSPORT and the minimum evidence dimensions above before it executes.
recommended_next_work.gate: HOLD until remote durable transport and end-to-end composition are exercised, not merely unit-modeled.
